title: Shaped section geometry and translation invariance
construction: Connect b=0.8, h=0.6, VPx=[0.5,0.7,1], and VPy=[0,0.5,1] to Section Builder.
Duplicate VSect four times into one ordered list and connect Span=6 to Beam Builder.
Measure section area/centroid/inertia and beam volume with core Grasshopper components.
Create a reinforcement circle of area 0.002 m2 centered at Z=-0.55 m.
Connect the canonical section and circle to Cracking Moment.
Translate both curves by +1 m in Z and connect them to a second Cracking Moment.
Export canonical and translated observations without rotating the benchmark.

gates.geometry: Section is closed, planar, valid, non-self-intersecting, with six unique vertices.
gates.beam: Beam Builder returns one valid closed Brep with analytic volume.
gates.characterization: Current coordinate-dependent Mcr values match characterization rows.
gates.corrected_acceptance: Corrected Mcr is invariant under translation within rtol 1e-7.
